packages.title: X AMPLIFY - POVMA SPONSORSHIP
packages.notes:
"POVMA has always been for the fans â€" delivering the VMA experience from perspectives audiences canâ€™t see on the broadcast. Originally conceived as a behind-the-scenes livestream capturing the real-time energy of the show through backstage cameras, audience reactions, and artist POVs, POVMA has become a fan-favorite digital companion to the VMAs, generating millions of views and viral moments.

In 2026, POVMA will supersize the fan experience across all social platforms, and extend access beyond the walls of the venue. Itâ€™s no longer just about literal POV camera angles â€" itâ€™s about unlocking the VIP POV, giving fans unprecedented access to the moments, spaces, and conversations that live behind the velvet rope.

For the first time ever, POVMA partners will kick off VMA season through a shared sponsorship of general voting, aligning their brands with one of the most engaged-with moments of the VMAs. As a fan-voted award show, integrating POVMA into this early-season voting moment will unlock the opportunity for partners to tap into the height of fan enthusiasm â€" activating around the posts, content, and conversations that mobilize fandoms before the show even begins.

From powering general voting engagement to unlocking VIP access during VMA weekend, POVMA 2026 expands the definition of POV â€" transforming the program into a full-funnel fan experience that brings audiences closer to the VMAs than ever before.

POVMA (TBD platforms, MTV/VMA)

1x lead up tune-in reminder 
2x polls
2x payoffs, captured from shoot
1x BTS videos from shoot
1x Halftime performance, TBD handles 
2x show highlights, content pool, TBD handles


*Concept and rollout subject to change per network feedback and program genesis."
